priority: Google account mode and demo mode parity
safe operation summary and live validation

authentication.method: Google OAuth Client ID entry with browser session persistence
authentication.principle: use Gmail API only for live data

credential-setup.oauth-consent-screen: configure the app audience before sign-in
credential-setup.test-user-addresses-note: These are documentation examples only; replace them with the real Gmail addresses used for testing and add every address in Google Cloud Console > Google Auth platform > Audience > Test users.

behavior: persist client ID locally in browser storage
re-open the Google setup panel when needed

features:gmail-label-management: allow source selection for visible, selectable labels
with an empty filter, clear all source selections when the Source header is activated while any source is selected
with an empty filter, select all visible selectable labels when the Source header is activated with no sources selected
double-click a label to select every non-system label with exactly the same name
keep existing source selections when double-click selection adds labels with the same name
rename labels inline with current label path in summary
delete labels only when they are empty and not system labels
block system labels from action flows
hide test-only labels from Google results
refresh mail counts after affected operations
refresh mail counts for every label row currently visible when the Mails column header is activated

demo-mode.purpose: allow UI testing without a Google account
behavior: load a built-in dataset of fake Gmail labels
keep the UI fully interactive in demo mode
clearly indicate when the application is running without a live Google session

shared-behavior: use a common operation model across demo and Google modes
keep operation summary and validation in sync
ignore deleted labels when Gmail returns a 404 during refresh
mode-parity.demo-mode: simulate label and mail-count updates locally
mode-parity.google-account-mode: execute Gmail API operations and refresh label data from the API
mode-parity.prohibited: never display stale label data from a deleted Gmail label

interface.layout: single unified tree with a compact operation summary and top-right control panel
components: mode-toggle: Demo and Google with strong active state colors
connection-status-box: shows connection state and user identity
google-popup: floating configuration panel anchored to the Google button
operation-summary-top: displays source, target, and operation direction
label-hierarchy: tree with Label, Mails, Source, Target, and Actions columns
source-selection: visible and selectable labels can be selected with one click
target-selection: single radio button for the target label
actions-column: inline rename and delete actions
tree-toolbar: filter, expand all, collapse all, and refresh controls
mail-count-refresh: activate the Mails column header to refresh counts for visible rows
operation-preview: create the same task rows as Run with zero progress and no side effects

tree-view: 5 columns: Label, Mails, Source, Target, Actions
label icon displayed before each label name
expand/collapse controls for each node and global expand/collapse
source selection respects the active filter and excludes system labels
with an empty filter, Source header toggles between clearing all sources and selecting all visible selectable labels
double-click selection uses exact label names, excludes system labels, and refreshes the newly selected mail counts
Mails header refreshes counts for rendered rows only, respecting the active filter and expanded branches
delete action is disabled for system labels and non-empty labels
loading spinner displayed while Gmail labels are fetched
dry-run: Preview creates one pending task row per executable operation with processed count set to zero
display progress for the active operation

gmail-api: use the official Gmail API only for live data
keep label tree updates consistent with the latest Gmail response
refresh the affected mail counts after each successful operation
refresh visible label mail counts in parallel when the Mails header is activated
handle stale deleted labels gracefully by ignoring 404 responses
collision-handling: show the real paths in the summary before execution
keep rename target names aligned with the actual label being renamed

scale: support practical Gmail label trees in normal mailbox usage
handle label filtering and bulk selection without layout disruption
performance: avoid unnecessary Gmail detail requests for deleted or collapsed labels
keep progress feedback visible during execution

unit: verify auth errors and API responses

safety: require explicit user intent before applying label changes
gracefully skip deleted labels when Gmail returns missing-entity responses

goals: deliver a robust Gmail label management experience
keep the UI compact and clear for everyday operations
maintain safe Google-account workflows with reliable refreshes
ensure documentation and behavior stay aligned with the shipped product
